correctness.rationale: For each unchosen edge uv the exact condition \(d_F(u)+d_F(v)=1\) yields the W/Y/B local rules and a converse. The 81-state left-to-right automaton has 13 starts, 13 ends, reachable and co-reachable sets each of size 15, and exactly 7 useful states: a six-cycle with permissible endpoints at phases 0,1,3,4, plus the BB self-loop. Walks of \(\(n-2\)\) transitions yield precisely 4,2,2 nontrivial configurations mod 3, and their selected weights are n by exact six-step weight periodicity. The BB state contributes z^(3\(\(n-2\)\)). The included standard-library program constructs and checks this finite state reduction and independently exhausts edge subsets for \(2\le n\le7\).

value.rationale: The open ladder is a natural connected series-parallel family. The complete exact classification reveals only 3 or 5 PEDS irrespective of length, all proper ones have minimum size n, and none is an efficient edge dominating set. The period-three boundary constraint contrasts sharply with stricter periodic closure and is mathematically structural, not a single special-case count or cosmetic rename. The explicit rational bivariate length/cardinality generating function permits exact weight sampling.
